findings.title: Error timestamps are compared against replay event timestamps in different units
findings.body: Nodestore error events carry `timestamp` in float seconds (line 115). Replay recording events (rrweb) normally carry their `timestamp` in milliseconds. `gen_request_data` compares `error_events[error_idx]["timestamp"] < event.get("timestamp", 0)` directly. With real data every error looks earlier than the first breadcrumb, so all errors are emitted at the start of the log instead of at their chronological position. The tests hide this because they use seconds for both.

findings.title: All error events are re-sent with every paginated page
findings.body: `on_results=functools.partial(analyze_recording_segments, error_events)` runs once per page of segment metadata. Each call builds a separate Seer request with the full error list. Errors later than the page's last event are appended at the end of every page, so they are duplicated across pages. Errors from outside a page's time range also appear in it, out of order. The error list should be filtered by each page's time range, or the pages should be combined before the Seer request is built.

findings.title: Feature-flagged table widget renders an empty table
findings.body: When the `use-table-widget-visualization` flag is on, `TableWidgetVisualization` is rendered with `columns={[]}` and `tableData` set to empty `data` and empty `meta`. The real `result.data`, `result.meta` and `loading` are ignored. Every table widget for flagged orgs shows no columns and no rows. If this is deliberate scaffolding, it needs a TODO. Otherwise the result should be mapped into `TabularData`.

findings.title: Query key omits the organization, and the migration dropped the old request settings
findings.body: The key is `['use-trace-item-attribute-keys', queryOptions]`. `queryOptions` has no organization slug, but the fetch URL is org-specific. Two orgs with the same page filters and item type share a cache entry, so one org can be served the other's attributes. The previous `useApiQuery` also set `staleTime: 0`, `refetchOnWindowFocus: false` and `retry: false`, and sent `environment`. The new `useQuery` call uses defaults, so it retries and refetches on window focus.

findings.title: Analytics event recorded before the feature-flag check
findings.body: `analytics.record("preprod_artifact.api.assemble", ...)` runs before the `organizations:preprod-artifact-assemble` check. The event fires for organizations that don't have the feature, and the endpoint then returns 404. Usage metrics are skewed by requests that are rejected. The call should come after the feature check.

findings.title: Per-issue event lookup when building the PR comment
findings.body: `get_environment_info` calls `issue.get_recommended_event()` for each issue while the comment body is built. That is a separate event fetch per issue (up to 5), and it adds latency to the comment workflow. The catch-all `except Exception` hides failures and logs them only at info level. Fetching the environment in bulk, or from data already loaded, would be cheaper.
